actual_tool_arguments.prompt: Create one original horizontal 3:2 pixel-art environment style-study image, an unoccupied low-magic medieval place. Use a fixed elevated three-quarter view, nearly orthographic, no dramatic perspective, no horizon or cinematic depth of field. Use deliberately clear chunky pixel clusters, crisp stepped contours and modest grouped shading; each material should read through a few broad muted tones before texture. Restrained weathered brown wood, grey stone, earthy ground and sparse dull olive grass. Keep generous readable ground and uninterrupted paths, with roughly one third of the composition quiet open ground or water. The main landmarks must remain immediately legible at a reduced viewing size. Do not fill every surface with grain, speckles, photoreal microtexture or painterly scratches. No smooth realistic rendering, 3D render, soft antialiasing, blur, glow, modern equipment, characters, creatures, UI, captions, readable writing, numbers, arrows or overlaid grid. Opaque complete scene, no alpha, no collage, no split panels. This is a visual proposal for an original place, not a playable map and not a reproduction of a specific Stoneshard screenshot. Show a modest riverside backup well and a river sampling bank. Place a single grey stone well on the dry bank slightly left of center, a simple rope-and-bucket lift, and a small ordinary timber filtering rack nearby. Along the visible shallow curved river edge on the right arrange exactly THREE clearly separate modest sampling positions, each with one plain ordinary borrowing bucket resting on a small reachable dry patch. All three must be individually countable and linked by the same broad dry bank path; they are sampling positions, not three wells, not medical tubes, and do not certify water purity. Use dark subdued blue water and a few pale shallow-bank stones. Near the rear dry return side, under one very small plain lean-to, show exactly two distinct CLOSED plain wooden cabinets separated by a small gap: one for anonymous sample/number records and one for private identity correspondence. Communicate separation only through their separate bodies and position, never readable labels or names, and do not show documents inside. Leave a clear open return path leading out of the lower-left edge; it must not terminate at the water or a fence. Buildings stay small, no whole village, no ship boarding, no crowds, no completed repair celebration, no signed agreement, no tickets or visual success indicators. Bucket handles are simple and readable. Left/right placement is only an art proposal; no map compass or world coordinates.

actual_tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit the attached original riverside well concept image. This is the sole style correction, not a new composition. Preserve the fixed elevated nearly orthographic 3:2 horizontal camera, the exact relative arrangement and clear dry paths, ONE stone well with rope lift, ONE separate ordinary timber filtering rack, exactly THREE riverbank sampling buckets each on its own reachable dry landing along the right curved shore, and TWO separate CLOSED cabinets under the small rear-left shelter. Preserve the broad lower-left dry return exit. Preserve opaque background. Do not add people, animals, monsters, readable text, UI, arrows, grids, magic, crystals, success indicators, open documents or water-quality certifications.
REDRAW THE PIXEL LANGUAGE SUBSTANTIALLY. The current image has far too many tiny grass blades, speckled rocks, flowers, dirt particles and wood-grain scratches. Replace these with large deliberate pixel clusters and broad calm flat areas. Aim for the visible chunkiness of an approximately 384 by 256 hand-pixeled source enlarged fourfold by nearest-neighbor, as a VISUAL aesthetic only. Make stepped blocky edges unambiguous. Do not retain microtexture. Each rock face uses only TWO or THREE clear tonal blocks. Cabinet and roof planks use broad flat brown bands with at most a few dark notches, no fine grain. Grass appears as sparse large grouped olive silhouettes with a few stepped tips, not individual tiny blades. Remove all small yellow flower dots and most scattered dirt pebbles. Earth paths should be predominantly calm uniform brown shapes with sparse grouped shadow patches. River should be broad quiet dark blue color planes with only a few short stepped ripple clusters, no dense tiny surface flecks. Keep roughly a third of the image quiet ground/water. Use a limited subdued palette of weathered brown timber, grey stone, muted earth, olive and dark blue. Object silhouettes and landmark counting must remain clear when reduced. Retain the practical low-magic medieval mood and modest environment scale. No painting, no photorealistic rendering, no 3D sheen, no soft blending, no smooth anti-aliasing, no blur. This should look like intentionally simplified crisp pixel-art scene concept, not the detailed old image with a filter. Do not create new buildings or additional wells/cabinets/sampling sites. All locations and object counts are a concept proposal, not a playable map or completed story state.
